methodology.client: agent:false, fresh downstream TCP per request; no browser cache, no concurrent requests
methodology.cold: new authenticated device each round, index+4 entry assets fetched sequentially, not LCP
methodology.warm: same device/URL/encoding, four entry assets repeated
methodology.conditional: same asset cache with validators; backend implements weak ETag comparison on both versions
methodology.dynamic: synthetic JSON API negative control, all requests must reach upstream on both versions
methodology.timing: wall time including raw HTTP reading and decoding assertions; two warm-up rounds excluded; three variant order rotated and reversed across rounds
methodology.bytes: actual socket bytesRead/bytesWritten per fresh HTTP connection; excludes TCP/IP/TLS framing
methodology.baselineSource: git archive, unmodified source; working tree does not replace gzip baseline with uncompressed proxy
methodology.compression: 20 sync encodes per codec/file after 3 warmups, alternating order; time isolated from HTTP
